name: pulse_catalog_inspect
description: Inspect the workspace Pulse automation catalog: configured event sources (with all signing secrets redacted), registered built-in and custom event JSON schemas, available collaboration Bots and Groups, and the 5 Dual-Primitive Workflow orchestrator presets (`direct_reflex`, `superagent_router`, `hybrid_pipeline`, `event_saga`, `window_aggregator`). Call this before authoring a Pulse rule or workflow so source kinds, event types, `memberId`s, and `spaceId`s come from live workspace state rather than guesswork.

project_id.description: Optional project UUID to scope rules and sources.

name: pulse_event_define
description: Register or update a custom SDK/internal event JSON Schema (`event_type`, `summary`, `json_schema`) in the Pulse catalog. Validates the event type namespace (`<domain>.<entity>.<action>`) and the entire JSON Schema tree exhaustively in a single pass (No Fail-Fast).

event_type.description: Dot-namespaced lowercase event identifier, e.g. `ci.coverage.dropped` or `release.canary.failed`.

summary.description: Concise human/agent summary of when this event fires and what its payload carries.

name: pulse_event_emit
description: Emit a structured custom `EventEnvelope` (`sdk_custom` / `trusted_internal`) into the Pulse intake pipeline with optional external `thread_key` correlation and automatic `trace.hopCount` loop-guard propagation (hard limit <= 5).

payload.description: Structured JSON payload matching the event schema.

correlations.description: Optional secondary correlation keys for context enrichment without fanout.

delivery_id.description: Optional idempotency key; auto-generated when omitted.

source_instance_id.description: Optional SDK/custom source instance identifier; defaults to `vibex-mcp`.

hop_count.description: Optional explicit trace hop count; automatically incremented from parent run context when present.

name: pulse_timer_schedule
description: Create a temporal Pulse rule driven by `cron` (`time_cron`), `once` (`time_once`), `interval` (`time_interval`), or `inactivity_sla` (`time_sla`), targeting `session`, `bot`, `group`, `user`, or `workflow`. Respects `MandateOrigin`: untrusted external turns are automatically coerced to `draftOnly=true`, `enabled=false`, `evalMode=observe`.

id.description: Optional existing rule ID to update.

eval_mode.description: Defaults to `observe` for safe rollout; `auto` executes immediately when due (if caller MandateOrigin permits).

enabled.description: Whether the schedule is active immediately (coerced to `false` when MandateOrigin is `untrusted_external` or `draft_only`/`propose_only` is true).

draft_only.description: When true, saves as a draft proposal with `evalMode=observe` and `enabled=false`.

temporal.description: Tagged temporal spec: `{ kind: 'cron', expression, timezone, weekdaysOnly?, catchUpOnce? }`, `{ kind: 'once', fireAt }`, `{ kind: 'interval', everySeconds, skipIfBusy? }`, or `{ kind: 'inactivity_sla', threadKeyPrefix, timeoutSeconds, expectedEventTypes? }`.

name: pulse_rule_propose_or_save
description: Exhaustively validate (No Fail-Fast) and propose or save a `PulseRuleSpec`. Enforces the `MandateOrigin` security invariant: when caller provenance is `untrusted_external` (e.g. an Agent turn triggered by an external webhook or chat) or `propose_only`/`draft_only` is requested, `enabled=true` and `evalMode=auto` are coerced to `draftOnly=true`, `enabled=false`, `evalMode=observe`.

id.description: Optional existing rule ID to update.

enabled.description: Requested activation flag (coerced to `false` under `untrusted_external` MandateOrigin or `draft_only`/`propose_only`).

draft_only.description: When true, saves as a proposal card awaiting human confirmation (`evalMode=observe`, `enabled=false`).

webhook_route_id.description: Optional webhook source route ID bound to this rule.

name: pulse_rule_dry_run
description: Sandbox-evaluate a `PulseRuleSpec` against a sample `EventEnvelope` with zero side effects. Returns exhaustive validation violations (all defects in 1 turn), unmatched `GateFilterAst` condition indices, anti-loop guard checks (`isSelf`, `hopCount`), and rendered prompt/message previews for every target.

name: pulse_thread_subscribe
description: Subscribe or unsubscribe a `session`, `bot`, `group`, or `workflow` to an external `thread_key` (e.g. `jira:PROJ-123`, `github:org/repo#42`, `feishu:om_xxx`) so follow-up replies route directly without requiring repeated `@` mentions.

action.description: `subscribe` binds a target to `thread_key`; `unsubscribe` deactivates an existing subscription.

thread_key.description: External correlation thread key (`<platform>:<id>`, e.g. `jira:PROJ-123`, `github:org/repo#42`, `feishu:om_xxx`). Required for `subscribe`.

subscriber_kind.description: Target receptor class (`session`, `bot`, `group`, or `workflow`). Required for `subscribe`.

subscription_id.description: Subscription ID when `action` is `unsubscribe` (optional if `thread_key` + `subscriber_id` are provided).
